plugins.name: gaia
plugins.description: GAIA — Generative AI Interface for Agents. Security-first multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code and OpenCode; this entry is the Claude Code plugin, and OpenCode runs on the npm package @jaguilar87/gaia. Specialized agents cover the full development lifecycle — analysis, planning, execution, deployment — with codebase-aware context injection. Every command is risk-classified: read-only runs freely, state changes pause for your approval, and irreversible operations are permanently blocked.
